note: City of Ashland park on Lake Superior's Chequamegon Bay beside the city ore dock and boat launch, with a swimming beach, a playground and a pavilion. The lakefront row (25-33) backs onto the bay with only the waterfront trail between; the other sites sit inland on the loop. --Claude
summary: City page, 2026 site map and imagery read: 2027 rates $55 / lakefront $60 confirm the stored fees; 33 RV-only sites, water + 30/50A, no sewer, showers/dump confirmed; season May 15-Oct 15 (2026 extended to Oct 25; stored close 10-24 -> 10-15); Campspot + phone booking, 2027 opens Feb 10. Bayfront confirmed on sites 25-33.
flags: WATERFRONT: bayfront confirmed. The city's site map (drawn on an aerial) and Esri imagery put the lakefront row - sites 25-33, priced 'Kreher Lakefront Site' $60 and sold by the night - on back-in spurs pointing at Chequamegon Bay from the outer loop road; the paved waterfront trail and a grass strip with scattered trees lie between, the pads ~15-30 m from the water over open ground. Row centre ~46.5982,-90.8806 (31/30) to ~46.5996,-90.8790 (27/26). Sites 1-24 are inland (not on the water).

SEASON: stored close 10-24 came from Campspot's 2026 record (the mild-weather extension to Oct 25); the city's standing statement is May 15-Oct 15. If the stored season is treated as manual, keep it and add the note instead.
PIN: stored 46.5969,-90.8825 is the beach parking lot; site centroid ~46.5978,-90.8800 (~215 m NE) - under the 250 m line, optional.
LONG-STAY: monthly stays sold ($1,320), but nightly sold on every site and 5 lakefront sites cap stays at 14 days; a city park, not a seasonal-lease park. Google 4.4 (284).
PHONE 715-682-7059 and WEBSITES confirmed. Sister city campground Prentice Park is already entry 3454.
